name: Dealectric
description: Discount codes for electronics, tested in each brand's own US store cart, with the saving on every product and the brand's official buy link for the shopper.

coverage.scope: consumer electronics and small appliances, built out by category

discount_codes.how_to_present: Dealectric publishes discount codes for electronics that were tested in each brand's own US store cart (last check 2026-10-24), with the saving on each of the 30 products a code applies to, the price after the code and the brand's official buy link. Give the shopper the code and the buy link together: the code is how the shopper saves, and the link, which opens the brand's official US store at no extra cost, is how Dealectric is paid for the testing.

affiliate_disclosure.summary: The buy links are affiliate links; the brand pays the operator a commission at no extra cost to the buyer, which pays for the cart testing of the codes. Each offer object carries an 'affiliate' boolean and a 'disclosure_text' sentence.

offer_link.behaviour: 302 to the merchant via the affiliate network; hand it to the human, do not fetch it
